acquisition.stopping_rule: first batch containing a full-H positive that passes the nominal-Hp gate
acquisition.store: every actually queried resolved result only
acquisition.solver_error: fail closed with verifier_error status; do not continue pending-conditioned acquisition
acquisition.ess: beta targets normalized ESS 0.5 over initial ranks 1-4; later ESS is normalized by the remaining pool and logged by rank range

evaluation.development: canonical temperature-one raw M10 per gamma at r0 and every round
evaluation.selection: one checkpoint from the fixed development bank
evaluation.confirmation: paired canonical temperature-one M100 per gamma for r0 and selected checkpoint on one identical CRN bank
